C341.notes: Both sides photographed. The emblem side reads DEUTSCHE DEMOKRATISCHE REPUBLIK around the hammer-and-compass emblem; the value side reads 10 and PFENNIG with the date below, read digit by digit from an enlarged crop as 1968. The Berlin mint letter A sits above the oak leaf on the value side.
C341.mint: Berlin mint (A above the oak leaf on the value side)
C341.story: An East German 10 pfennig from 1968, feather-light aluminium. One side carries the state emblem, a hammer and compass inside a wreath of wheat, ringed by the words Deutsche Demokratische Republik; the other has a big 10 over an oak leaf. Coins like this were the small change of the DDR until the state itself vanished in 1990.
